Name: Suntooth's Silly Recolours
Author: Suntooth
Description:
[size=5][b]WARNING: Many options in this mod will hurt your eyes - do not use this mod if you are sensitive to eyestrain![/b][/size]

[size=3][i]"Hey, I bet I could use indexed colour palettes in Photoshop to make some silly SDV recolours!" - a person about to put way too much work into an impractical mod[/i][/size]

[size=3]Have you ever wanted to make your game look genuinely awful? Have you ever wanted to play SDV in true B&W, or only with fully saturated colours? Do I have the mod for you![/size]

[size=3]This 500mb behemoth contains a variety of options, with dithering options (0%, 40%, 100%) for colour palettes where it makes sense. Languages other than English are generally not supported. The default option is grayscale with 0% dithering - use Generic Mod Config Menu to choose your palette and dithering. Many palette names are a bit impenetrable because they're the internal names I used while making them and I haven't come up with proper names for them.[/size]

[size=3]I absolutely do not recommend using this mod for everyday gameplay, but I can't stop you. Use it at your own risk.[/size]

[size=3]Visual examples of each palette are in the spoiler below. They're also available in the mod files. [b]Eyestrain warning![/b][/size]
